title: Good: defense-in-depth re-sanitization pattern
description: activitypub.rs consistently re-sanitizes HTML at output time (lines 333, 347, 350, 425, 466) with ammonia::clean even though content_html was already sanitized at write time. This is a genuine defense-in-depth practice -- if a bug in the write path or a database corruption introduces malicious HTML, the output path catches it. The pattern is applied consistently across profile_page, post_page, and the OG description extraction. Well done.
